up: Retrieve all IC50 activity values (standard_value and standard_units) against the HepG2 cell line (CHEMBL395) for the compound CHEMBL3338195 and all of its salt forms. The results should include the canonical SMILES for each compound. Use the molecule_hierarchy table to identify all salts (children) where CHEMBL3338195 is the parent. Join the resulting set of molregnos to the activities table via compound_records and assays, filtering for assays where tid matches CHEMBL395 and standard_type is 'IC50'.
sql:
WITH compound_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT parent.molregno AS parent_molregno,
         parent.chembl_id AS parent_chembl_id,
         child.molregno AS child_molregno,
         child.chembl_id AS child_chembl_id,
         COALESCE(child.molregno, parent.molregno) AS query_molregno
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  LEFT JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
  LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3338195'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  ch.child_chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM compound_hierarchy ch
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.molregno = ch.query_molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = ch.query_molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = ass.tid
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL395';
